fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-09-19, Rs. 75,000 was debited from the account of the complainant through UPI after a collect request from an unknown UPI ID was approved. The time of the incident was given as 00:05 on 2025-09-16. Ravi Gopal submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000098. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100082 as the destination of the transfer. The complaint mentions Gokul Gopal, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000195, in connection with the events. Rajesh Krishnan (9000000167) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Potentially relevant material referenced includes digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as an online buyer and requested payment approval.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, suspect, digital document, mobile number, shopping complex, night, witness
